models.title: Portfolio/benchmark return as weight-times-return sum

relationship.original_equation: R = sum w_i R_i (Eq1); B = sum W_i B_i (Eq2)
relationship.translation_notes: Family W holds precomputed w_i x R_i (or W_i x B_i) products (multiplication documented here as the per-element construction; no elementwise family arithmetic in the grammar). Decimals (unit 1).

variables.source_symbol: w_i x R_i per sector (introduced family of products)
variables.definition: Sector weight times sector return, decimal
variables.context: one portfolio or benchmark at one date

variables.definition: Portfolio (Eq1) or benchmark (Eq2) total return, decimal

assumptions: Weights and returns contemporaneous; weights sum to 100% (leverage via negative weights if present).
limitations: Single-period, single-currency accounting identity; compounding across periods is geometric, not this sum.
